changes.title: Changes
changes.noWorktree: This graph does not give each worker its own worktree, so there is no branch to compare. Start a graph with worktrees to see what each worker changed.
changes.nothingTouched: This chat has not written any file.
changes.stepsOnly: This chat does not work in a git checkout, so its edits are read from the conversation, one step at a time.

checklist.title: Its checklist
checklist.none: It has not written a checklist.

health.title: Health
health.cancelBody: Only this command's processes are stopped. The turn goes on: the worker gets a failed result for the command and decides what to do next.
health.hintExplained: Written for this signal; edit it before sending.
health.interruptHint: Interrupts the turn that is running. The chat stays open and waits for what you send next.

short.waiting: A permission, a question or a plan
short.context: Compacts on its own when it fills

loop.semantic: Looks like the same attempt again

weakenedTest.weakMatchers: Matchers that pass for almost anything

short.noProgress: No commit and no file changed

activity.title: Doing now
activity.thinking: No command is running: it is thinking or writing.
activity.lastEvent: Last event in the transcript {{time}} ago.

task.title: Work of {{name}}
task.notStarted: This task has not started, so it has done nothing yet.

supervisor.intro: When a worker's health turns bad, a small model reads its last steps and proposes a hint of one or two lines. The proposal shows on the worker's health, where you send it, edit it first or dismiss it. It asks once per signal per chat, and each answer is a housekeeping chat of the CLI, counted in the cost of the worker's orchestration.
supervisor.enabled: Propose hints for workers that look stuck
supervisor.modelHint: A small one is enough: it reads a few lines and writes two.
supervisor.maxCostHint: Passed to the CLI as --max-budget-usd for each question.
supervisor.costInvalid: The limit has to be above $0 and at most ${{max}}.
supervisor.autoSend: Send each proposal to the worker on its own
supervisor.autoSendHint: Off, a proposal waits for you. On, it reaches the worker as soon as it is written, and stays on the health card as sent.
supervisor.title: The supervisor's proposal
